title: telanthophora uspantanensis
intro: Telanthophora uspantanensis, commonly known as "Hierba de la Virgen" or "Mexican Sage", is a plant species native to Mexico and Guatemala. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Telanthophora uspantanensis include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
